name: Research: native chapter format and legacy path
outcome: Settled the native format: CommonMark+GFM with GFM-alert callouts and typed YAML fenced blocks (figure, figures, diagram, svg, quiz, sources), no raw HTML, 422 at ingest; a 7-kind diagram vocabulary on fixed layouts (Mermaid rejected); a reject-at-ingest SVG allowlist; quiz types choice/recall/cloze with a saved-result payload; ids on headings, typed blocks and quiz items; chapter:/doc:/asset:/#id references; .md + 'format: native'; a full-screen legacy frame with a scroll/link bridge and no height measurement; print; D38/D39/D40 obsolete, D37 absorbed, D25 deferred; /explain and CLI changes; 3 operator questions (portable skill copy, JS widgets, math)
